name: Scientist
description: Scientist Format is a DM era format that predates the first ban list. The latest core set is Magician’s Force (MFC). Notable additions include Breaker the Magical Warrior, Magical Scientist, Tribe-Infecting Virus, and Royal Decree. This is the only format in the history of the TCG with 3 legal copies of Magical Scientist, and thus Scientist FTK is quite potent here.

defining_cards.name: Magical Scientist
defining_cards.why: Repeated payments of 1000 LP supplied Fusion Monsters for combat or for Catapult Turtle to tribute before they returned to the Fusion Deck.

defining_cards.name: Dark Balter the Terrible
defining_cards.why: This Level 5 Fusion could shut off effects of monsters it defeated in battle and negate a Normal Spell for 1000 LP.

defining_cards.name: Catapult Turtle
defining_cards.why: Its original effect could tribute several monsters in one turn, converting Magical Scientist's Fusion Monsters into lethal damage.

defining_cards.name: Breaker the Magical Warrior
defining_cards.why: Its Spell Counter gave it 1900 ATK or could be spent to destroy a Spell or Trap before committing another attacker.

defining_cards.name: Ryu Senshi
defining_cards.why: Magical Scientist could call this Level 6 Fusion to negate a Normal Trap and protect a critical attack.
